title: Singleton mass under the uniform law on a bit
statement: Under the uniform probability law on the two Boolean values, each individual outcome $b$ carries mass exactly $\tfrac{1}{2}$; that is, the singleton event $\{b\}$ has probability $\tfrac{1}{2}$ for either choice of $b$.
hypotheses_covered: b is a Boolean value (either outcome)
replaced: Each bit has mass $1 / 2$ under the uniform law on one bit.
